title: Dream of the Red Chamber: first printed 120-chapter edition (1791)
summary: Cao Xueqin's novel Dream of the Red Chamber, written in the mid-18th century in Qing-dynasty China, circulated in versions ending by chapter 80. In 1791 Cheng Weiyuan and Gao E brought together the first printed 120-chapter edition; later readers think the last 40 chapters were written by someone other than Cao.

uncertainty.note: Both sources give 1791 for the printed edition. The novel itself was written around the mid-18th century (China Daily).

as_recorded.value: first printed edition of 120 chapters brought together by Cheng Weiyuan and Gao E in 1791
illustrated and printed in woodblock in 1791, among the novel's earliest editions
